subject: maths
question: A 35% profit is made when a discount of 35% is given on the marked price of an item. When the discount is 45%, then the profit percentage will be:
solution:
**Given:**

A 35% profit is made when a discount of 35% is given on the marked price of an item.

**Formula used:**

MP/CP = (100 + profit%) / (100 - discount%)

Profit% = [(SP - CP) / CP] × 100

**Calculations:**

MP/CP = (100 + 35) / (100 - 35) = 135 / 65

⇒ MP/CP = 27/13

MP = 27, CP = 13

If discount is 45%, then 

SP = 27 - 27 × 45/100 = 27(1 - 45/100) = 27 × 55/100 = 297/20 = 14.85

So, profit = SP - CP = 14.85 - 13 = 1.85

Thus, Profit% = 1.85/13 × 100 = 185/13 = 14(3)/(13)%

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**
